captured_from.pattern_description: Capture the pattern: when a task description includes an 'Implementation Complete' section with deliverable counts and test counts, the task is a verification-only workload. The successful pattern was: (1) glob for deliverable files and count, (2) run test suite and assert count/zero-failures, (3) spot-check risk mitigations from the risk register. This pattern completed in ~3 minutes with high confidence. Codify as a lightweight DERIVED skill from self-verification.
